## What it is

Open electronics bay under the screen wedge. Front deck with four magnet towers; rear volume left empty for Atom / PSU / relays later.

## Design notes

- Tower XY layout mirrors the wedge floor wells (same face margins and 60° depth).
- Magnet wells are the workshop 8×3 / `puit_diametre` stack.
- Inner size is a placeholder until component dimensions land.

## Don't

- Don't size the bay around guessed component footprints — wait for measurements.
- Don't drop the magnet size below the proven 8×3 wells.
